scope: One versus two active isolated serial OCR workers through native Linux Rust SMTP, fixed synthetic originals, lexical/semantic models and two local scanners. Short shared-host capacity experiment, not filtering quality or representative sustained throughput.

deployment_pool_test.scope: Separate CI host and backend; exact assertions include both warmups. Not throughput.

configuration.fixture_control: A private wrapper overrides only the public fixture factory to copy the same previously generated image/PDF bytes across every trial. Original messages matched by raw SHA256; PDF generation timestamps do not vary between arms.
configuration.decoder_limits: Identical in both arms; each worker retains serial execution, 1 CPU, 900MiB memory and 128MiB temporary storage.

aggregation.capacity: Total complete messages / sum of drained_seconds for the two matched 16-message trials in each arm. Source elapsed seconds rounded to milliseconds.
aggregation.analysis_quantiles: Nearest-rank quantiles recomputed from each stored scan.elapsed_ms, including all 32 analyses per arm; never average trial quantiles.
aggregation.smoke: Two four-message checks included in totals and decision audit, excluded from capacity ratios.
aggregation.cpu: Cgroup deltas include per-trial probe/fixture/model startup; shared scanner CPU excluded. memory.peak is cumulative across this suite, not a per-trial measurement.

decision_audit.normalization: Compare the entire stored scan, including score, decision, action, tags, completeness, features, model outputs and evidence. Exclude only recursive elapsed_ms/elapsed_us and evidence.artifacts.policy_sha256; sort reasons.
decision_audit.policy_difference: vision.max_parallel differs between arms and is included in the policy digest. Socket and temporary runtime paths are absent from that digest. All config differences were audited; scoring settings, semantic budget and OCR decoder limits are unchanged.
decision_audit.vision_assertions: SMTP probe checks selected parts, pages, QR count and text-character minimum per original; it does not compare exact raw OCR text. Direct CI worker test separately checks expected text and QR content.

isolation.method: A private entry wrapper checks access inside each actual confined service, records capabilities, waits for both workers, checks the peer, then execs the unchanged pinned worker while preserving socket activation. The root controller confirms distinct identities and namespaces.

limitations: Synthetic fixed image/PDF/combined fixtures, shared host, repeated16-message trials; not representative sustained capacity.
Single vs pooled arms change SMTP processing/client concurrency and use one vs two active CPU-limited workers.
Both worker instances remain allocated; startup excluded from per-message latency, scanner services outside measured cgroups.
Per-trial cgroup CPU includes fixture/probe/model startup; cumulative memory peaks must not be treated as per-trial peaks.
DNS/authentication, reputation providers, LLM, TLS, Proton and filtering-quality evaluation excluded.
All pooled analysis p95 values remain above500ms; higher concurrency improves capacity, not individual analysis latency.
48 distinct synthetic originals repeated four or five times; repetition consistency does not establish capture or false-positive rates.
Shared scanner database hashes were not pinned in these scan artifacts; only model and OCR/backend hashes are verified.
No full installer upgrade/rollback execution, production switch, real isolated CAPEv2/Office evaluation or new Proton delivery-action validation.
